(2) On treatment: 5,360 of 5,984 US adults with SLE (89.572%) filled an SLE medication in 2023 (Figueroa-Parra G et al., Lupus Sci Med 2024;11(2), PMC11629018; OptumLabs). 0.16882 x 0.89572 = 0.151216, about 30,890 US patients and 2,157 newly eligible a year
